description: Request a showing for the person you are helping, at a listing (listingKey) or a building (buildingSlug). Requires their name and email, your agent block and humanConfirmed=true. They receive a confirmation email; use get_request_status with the returned token to follow up.

conversationRef.description: Optional opaque reference to this conversation (never a transcript)

vendor.description: Who you are: openai, anthropic, google, microsoft, perplexity, …

agentKey.description: Optional Own Miami agent key (raises limits, verifies attribution)

textVersion.description: Must be "tcpa-v1" when a phone is given

email.description: Their email — they receive a confirmation

name.description: Full name of the person you are helping

phone.description: Optional. Only with consent (read them the TCPA text at /for-ai)

humanConfirmed.description: You attest the person asked for this

name: request_tour
